view.sqlSentence: SELECT pcategory.id, pcategory.name, SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.quantity, 3)), SUM(TRUNCATE(invoice_detail.taxable_base * ((invoice_tax.percentage + invoice.surcharge + 100) / 100), 2)) FROM pcategory, invoice_detail, invoice, item, product, invoice_tax WHERE invoice_detail.item = item.id AND item.product = product.id AND product.category = pcategory.id AND invoice_detail.invoice = invoice.id AND invoice_tax.invoice_detail = invoice_detail.id AND invoice.type = ? AND invoice.issue_date BETWEEN ? AND ? GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 4 DESC
